name: mcp-mail
description: Self-hosted MCP server giving Codex access to your own mail, calendar, files, and read-only Teams chats across Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, IMAP, and local synced folders.

interface.shortDescription: Private local mail, calendar, files, and Teams chats
interface.longDescription: Connect your own Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, IMAP, and local synced folder accounts to Codex through a local MCP server. Teams chats are opt-in and read-only. Credentials stay in your operating system credential store.
